convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in iFractals indicator. Simple entry/exit rules with fixed SL/TP. No external .mqh libraries. No complex money management or multi-timeframe logic.

other_exits: Stop and reverse on opposite fractal breakout signal

custom_logic_notes: Fractal breakout strategy: places buy stop at upper fractal level and sell stop at lower fractal level. Pending orders are placed on new bar detection when fractal appears. SL/TP values are adjusted by multiplying by 10 when _Point < 0.001 (5-digit/3-digit broker normalization). Previous pending orders are deleted and replaced when a new fractal signal is detected.
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward conversion. Fractals can be computed from rolling high/low lookback (default 5-bar: 2 bars left + center + 2 bars right). Buy stop at upper fractal, sell stop at lower fractal with fixed SL/TP in pips. Remember to apply the 10x multiplier for SL/TP when point_size < 0.001. New bar guard is essential to avoid duplicate orders.
